name: co-tax-overview
description: Colombia tax overview and routing for income year 2026, distinguishing the 2026 filing calendar for earlier income from future returns. Covers taxpayer, residence/source, annual period, COP and UVT, ordinary personal marginal and corporate rates, conditional corporate minimum test and standard IVA. Routes individual, corporate, SIMPLE/formalisation, VAT, payroll, independent contributions, transfer pricing, cross-border and company-formation work to their owning Guides. Trigger on Colombian tax overview, impuestos Colombia, UVT 2026, DIAN, which tax return, tax residence and company versus individual tax. Includes one recomputing unit/marginal-band orientation case. Excludes complete return preparation, local tax, special-sector and treaty computations and unconfirmed future deadlines.
